tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ tshe 'das gnas 'dren bsdus pa bzhugs pa'i dbu phyogs so//

pad 'byung rtsa ba gsum la phyag 'tshal nas// zhi khro phyir ldog mdor bsdus 'dir bkod bya// lha dang srung ma'i tshogs kyis bka' gnang stsol// lha bshos lcog ldog chang bu ting lo bshams// mar me gcig kyang drung du bltams par bya// padma 'dab drug dbus dang bdun pa bya// de steng byang bu phyag len bzhin du btsug /zhi khro'i las byang bsdus pa tshar gcig gis// bdag mdun bum gsum cho ga gcig gis bsgrub// bum bskyed la dmigs bsnyen pa brgya rtsa bya/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thugs rje dang ldan pa: mkhyen pa dang ldan pa: brtse ba dang ldan pa rnams thugs rje'i dbang gis gnas 'dir byon cig: dngos su 'byor pa dang yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod pa bzhes shig: thugs rje can khyed rnams la mkhyen pa'i ye shes: brtse ba'i thugs rje: mdzad pa'i phrin las: skyobs pa'i nus mthu bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba lags pas: thugs rje can khyed rnams kyis tshe las 'das pa che ge zhes bya ba 'di: 'jig rten 'di nas pha rol tu ni 'gro: skyas chen po ni 'degs: grogs ni med: sdug bsngal ni che: skyabs ni med: mgon ni med: dpung gnyen ni med: tshe 'di'i snang ba ni nub: mun nag 'thug por ni 'jug: g.yang sa chen por ni ltung : las kyi dbang gis ni ded: sa tshugs med par ni 'gro: dbang ni med: gcig pur 'gro dgos pa'i dus la babs na: thugs rje can khyed rnams kyis tshe las 'das pa che ge skyabs med pa 'di la skyabs mdzod cig: mgon med pa 'di la mgon mdzod cig: dpung gnyen med pa 'di la dpung gnyen mdzod cig: bar do'i mun nag chen po las skyobs shig: las kyi rlung dmar chen po las zlog cig: gshin rje'i 'jigs skrag chen po las skyobs shig: bar do'i 'phrang ring chen po las sgrol cig: thugs rje can khyed rnams thugs rje ma chung zhig:

sngon gyi dam bca' ma g.yel bar thugs rje'i shugs myur ru phyungs shig: sems can las ngan pa'i dbang du ma btang cig: dkon mchog gsum gyis bar do'i sdug bsngal las bskyab tu gsol: ces ra mda' sbran pa'o/ oṃ badzra shrī he ru ka utstsha ta ya hūm̐ phaṭaḥ oṃ swā bha wa sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las yi ge nṛḥyongs su gyur pa las tshe las 'das pa'i phung khams skye mched yongs su rdzogs pa gson po'i rnam pa ji lta bar gyur: na mo: sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang : chos kyi bka' bden pa dang : dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang : bcom ldan 'das kun tu bzang po rdo rje sems dpa' zhi khro rab 'byams kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pas: tshe las 'das pa che ge mo'i rnam par shes pa sa 'og sa steng sa bla 'gro ba rigs drug lam rgyud lnga: srid pa bar ma do gar yod pa'i sa nas mtshan byang 'di la khug cig: lan gsum/ hūm̐: tshe 'das lus brjes rigs kyi bu khyod kyang : mdza' sdug brtse ba'i gnyen bshes grogs rnams dang : rtag tu 'grogs pa'i skal dang dbang med pas: mi lus tshe 'phos 'jig rten snang ba nub: rnam shes sems ni mi rtag tshul bstan te: las kyi dbang gis pha rol lus shig blangs: nyon mongs 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bskyed pa yi: skye gnas bzhi po ltung ba'i sar skyes kyang : gar skyes gang na gnas pa'i sa phyogs nas: brtse gdung yid la bcag pa'i gnyen 'brel gyis: dkon mchog gsum la skyabs song mthu rtsal dang : sangs rgyas mthu stobs chen po'i byin rlabs dang : chos nyid rnam par dag pa'i bden pa dang : sngags 'chang rtse gcig bsgrub pa'i byin rlabs dang : zhi khro rab 'byams lha tshogs thugs rje yis: lus med stong gzugs bar do'i rnam shes khyod: las dang nyon mongs dbang gis gar 'khyams kyang : dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pas 'dir khug cig: oṃ badzra satwa hūm̐: du pre su tri a nṛ yaṃ dzaḥ

badzra aṅku sha dzaḥ kye ma: dbang med las kyis pha rol tshe 'phos khyod: mi yi yul du skye ba grangs med kyang : las kyis 'brel ba'i 'dug sa 'di yin pas: 'phan phran mdzes pa 'di ni lus kyi rten: gser byang ming bris 'di ni ngag gi rten: me long gsal ba 'di ni sems kyi rten: ras phrug dri med 'di ni gos kyi rten: gdugs chen 'bar ba 'di ni gzhal yas khang : leb phying dkar po 'di ni 'dug pa'i gdan: sba smyug ldem pa 'di ni 'ju ba'i shing : thogs med 'ja' tshon 'dra ba'i yid lus khyod: dmigs pa'i rten 'jug 'di la gnas par gyis: tshe 'das che ge tiṣṭha badzra sa ma ya lhan: oṃ āḥhūm̐ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sambha ra sambha ra hūm̐: hūm̐: zhi khro rab 'byams lha tshogs bden pa'i mthus: tshe 'das lus brjes rigs kyi bu 'di yi: sa dang lam la bar du gcod byed pa'i: srog gcod mdangs 'phrog gshed ma'i tshogs rnams kun: mthu stobs byin rlabs mthu yis gzhan du dengs: hūm̐: nga nyid lha yi nga rgyal gyis: 'od dang 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros: steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad kun: rang rig stong gsal rig pa'i mdangs: kun bzang rigs lnga rdo rje sems: rab 'jigs khrag 'thung sprul pa'i tshogs: snang la rang bzhin med pa yis: rab tu gang nas 'od 'phros pas: tshe 'das 'di la gnod byed cing : srog gcod mdangs 'phrog gshin lcag bgegs: nyon mongs ma rig rgyu las byung : rgyu drug 'khor ba'i lam dgag phyir: 'di ru ma 'dug gzhan du dengs: hūm̐ hūm̐ u tsa ta ya phaṭaḥ oṃ sumbha ni nas bidya rā dza ya hūm̐ phaṭaḥ ces pas nas lcag brab bo: de nas bum pa thogs la/ 'di ni pha rol phyin bcu'i chu: dri ma rnam bcu sbyong byed cing : phar phyin bcu la legs 'god chu: phar phyin chu yis dag gyur cig: khrus legs mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo: oṃ badzra satwa hūm̐: na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐:

bye ma thogs la/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum: 'di dag 'jig rten dug gsum ste: rgyal ba rigs lnga dug mi mnga': sangs rgyas bden pas dug bcom mo: bden pa gang gis sangs rgyas rnams: 'jig rten kun tu bla na med: bden pa'i mchog ni 'di dag gis: khyod kyi dug lnga'i dug rnams ni: rang bzhin med par dag gyur cig: 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum: 'di dag 'jig rten dug gsum ste: dkon mchog gsum po dug mi mnga': dkon mchog bden pas dug bcom mo: bden pa'i bden tshig 'di dag gis: khyod lus dug gis mi tshugs shog: gshin gang dug dang bcas pa rnams: de kun dug gsum dug las byung : dug gsum dug ni dug gi mchog: drag po'i dug ni dug bcom mo: sngags brjod/ 'byung bzhi dug gi pha yin te: 'byung bzhi dug gi ma yang yin: bden pa'i bden tshig 'di brjod pas: dug rnams 'byung bzhi'i nang du song : gang ba'i snod du dug song la: khyod kyi dug ni dug med shog: dkon mchog gsum gyis dug bcom pas: dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song : dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang : ting 'dzin sngags kyi byin rlabs kyis: tshe 'das rigs kyi bu khyod kyi: dug rnams gtan nas dag gyur cig: sngags brjod/ de nas tshe 'das kyis gsol ba btab par bsam la/ kye ma mgon po thugs rje can: rigs drug gnas su 'khyams pa yi: skyabs bral mgon med sems can la: thugs rje'i lcags kyus bzung du gsol: chos bshad la/ bu khyod shin tu skal pa bzang : gang gis sgyu 'phrul zhi khro yi: dkyil 'khor lha la phyag 'tshal na: nyams chag kun kyang byang 'gyur zhing : mtshams med lnga yi sdig kyang 'byang : na raka gnas kyang dong sprugs te: rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i zhing du grags: de phyir dad pa'i shugs bskyed la: thub chen drug la gsol ba thob: tshe 'das des/ kye ma bdag 'dra'i sems can la: nyon mongs drug gi las dbang gis:

'gro ba rigs drug gnas su skyes: 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal brjod las 'das: sdug bsngal 'di las bdag drongs la: brtse ba chen pos bzung du gsol: slob dpon des/ kye ma tshe 'das lus brjes rigs kyi bu: nyon mongs drag pos kun nas bslangs nas su: mi dge bcu dang khyad par dug lnga yis: 'gro ba rigs drug gnas su skye srid pas: de na mgon dang skyabs su gyur pa ni: rigs drug thub pa bcom ldan drug po bzhugs: phar phyin chos ston nyon drug rnam par dag: 'gro drug thub pa so so'i phyag mtshan can: 'gro drug so so'i sdug bsngal sbyang du gsol: sprul sku thub pa drug la skyabs su mchi: de nas thub drug phyag mtshan thogs la/ hūm̐: tsha grang skyobs byed me chu bsil drod ldan: rin chen sgrom gyi bum pa dang : shes rab rig pa'i pu ti dang : shes rab don mtshon ral gri dang : bdud kyi mtshon srung go cha dang : pi waṃ snyan pa'i don byed dang : rin chen par bu lhung bzed rnams: tshe 'das khyod la dbang bskur bas: 'gro drug sdug bsngal las grol nas: 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bral bar shog: du da ha da ha sarba na ra ka ga te he tun hūm̐ phaṭaḥ pre pa tsa pa tsa sarba pre ta ka ga te he tun hūm̐ phaṭaḥ tri ma tha ma tha sarba tirya ka ga te he tun hūm̐ phaṭaḥ su sarba du la sarba karma pra we sha ya hūm̐ phaṭaḥ a sarba ta thā ga ta bidya khadga tshinda tshinda hūm̐ phaṭaḥ oṃ tshindha tshindha sarba a wa ra ṇa ni hūm̐ phaṭaḥbum pa/ hūm̐: kun bzang yab yum bum pa na: rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha tshogs bzhugs: tshe 'das khyod la dbang bskur bas: rigs drug skye sgo bcad nas ni: 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bral bar shog: oṃ badzra satwa hūm̐: oṃ buddha satwa oṃ: oṃ ratna satwa swā: oṃ padma satwa ā: oṃ karma satwa hā: hūm̐ badzra a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ oṃ buddha a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ swā ratna a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ ām̐ padma a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ

hā karma a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ lha bshos mchod cing changs bu ting lo lcog ldog bsngo ba ni/ hūm̐: bcom ldan thub pa drug po la: dri med dag pa'i zhal zas dang : 'dod yon rgyan gyi mchod gtor 'bul: tshe 'das lan chags sbyang du gsol: oṃ nai wi te pu dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐: glud bran la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sambha ra sambha ra hūm̐: hūm̐: gtor ma 'dod yon lnga dang ldan pa 'di: tshe 'das rigs drug lan chags bsnyag pa yi: gson bdud gshin lcag lan chags khyod la sbyin: gtor ma 'di yis mgu zhing tshim gyis la: tshe 'das 'di yi thar pa'i gegs ma byed: sarba bhu ta bha lingta kha kha khā hiḥ bye ma thogs la/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum: 'di dag 'jig rten dug gsum ste: kun bzang zhi khro dug mi mnga': sangs rgyas bden pas dug bcom mo: nyon drug dri ma dag gyur cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra satwa sa ma ya: sogs/ bum pa/ 'di ni phyin drug rang bzhin chu: nyon mongs drug po sbyong byed cing : phyin drug chu yis legs bkrus pas: nyon drug dri ma dag gyur cig: khrus legs mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo: oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hāḥ badzra satwa sa ma ya: sogs/ hūm̐: sa 'di bcad pa man chad ni: rigs drug 'khor ba'i gnas yin pas: bor ro spang ngo rigs kyi bu: yul dang khang khyim nor rdzas kun: sgyu ma'i rta glang ci bzhin du: mi rtag 'gyur ba'i chos can yin: rtag par gnas pa gcig kyang med: ma chags ma zhen rigs kyi bu: pha ma bu tsha nye drung kun: rmi lam skyes bu ji bzhin du: mi rtag 'bral ba'i chos can yin: khyod kyi ming nas 'bod byed cing : pha ma nye du nga yin zhes: smre sngags 'o dod 'bod pa kun: thar lam bar chad bgegs yin pas: de la ma nyan rigs kyi bu: chags par ma byed rigs kyi bu: sa 'di bcad pa yan chad ni: thar pa bde ba'i sa yin pas: 'dong ngo gshegs so rigs kyi bu:

dga' zhing spro ba'i sems bskyed la: zhing mchog gtsang ma'i gnas mchog tu: bdag gis khyod nyid 'jug bya yis: phyir mi ldog pa'i sa thob shog: dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa ni/ sa gzhi spos chus sogs/ e ma mgon po thugs rje can: bdag 'dra'i sems can 'khor bar 'khyams: log pa'i lam du zhugs lags pas: bde chen thar pa'i lam bstan 'tshal: dkyil 'khor chen por 'jug tu gsol: rdo rje theg pa'i dam tshig gang : byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol: thun mong dang ni khyad par gyi: skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol: dbang dang byin rlabs stsal du gsol: ces zhus nas/ kun bzang zhi khro'i lha tshogs la: 'di bzung bla med byang chub bar: tshe 'das gus pas skyabs su mchi: so sor thar pa'i sdom pa dang : bla med smon 'jug byang chub sems: rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig kun: ma lus bdag gis yongs su bzung : gsum/ hūm̐: dkyil 'khor chen po'i phyogs bzhi'i sgo: nyon sgrib bzhi pos bcad lags na: sgo ba khro bo yab yum brgyad: tshad med sgo ma gdong can bzhi: thabs shes phyag rgya bzhi po yis: ye shes bzhi yi sgo bzhi phyes: tshe 'das dad pas 'jug par bgyi: kun bzang zhi khro'i lha tshogs la: tshe 'das gus pas phyag 'tshal lo: yi dam lha dang mjal bar shog: pra we sha ya phaṭaḥ dkyil 'khor la me tog gtor bar bsam la/ pra titstsha hoḥ kye padma dri med ces bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o: mig dar blangs la/ oṃ badzra dzña na tsakṣu pra we sha ya phaṭaḥ dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos: lus ngag yid kyis dad pa bskyed: rdo rje sems dpa'i rigs su skyes: sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs: dngos grub thams cad khyod kyis thob: dam tshig sngags la brtson par gyis: hūm̐ las tshe 'das rdo rje sems dpa'i sku: dkar gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis 'dzum bcas bzhad: phyag g.yas rig stong rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin: g.yon pas snang stong dril bu dku la brten:

longs spyod rdzogs sku dar dang rin chen brgyan: g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs: thugs kar rdo rje hūm̐ la yig brgyas bskor: bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs nyams chag sdig sgrib kun: ma lus dag nas shel sgong lta bur gyur: oṃ badzra satwa sa ma ya: sogs nas satwa āḥ de nas dbang bzhi rdzogs par bskur gsungs pas/ hūm̐: bum pa 'di ni gzhal yas khang : nang na zhi khro'i lha tshogs bzhugs: phyi nang gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: sku gsung thugs kyi dbang bskur bas: phyi nang gsang ba'i dbang mchog rnams: skal ldan rnams la phab nas kyang : phung khams lha dang lha mor gyur: bskyed rim lha dbang thob par shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥswā hā: āḥ shes rab rig pa'i po ti 'di: dus gsum rgyal ba zhi khro'i gsung : tshe 'das khyod la dbang bskur bas: gsung dbang yongs rdzogs thob par shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐ bo dhi tsitta ma hā su kha dzña na dha tu āḥ oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐: wākka a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ hūm̐: rdo rje 'khor lo rin po che: padma rgya gram thugs kyi rtags: rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: 'khor lo lnga yi dbang thob shog: badzra tsakra ratna padma khadga a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ zhe sdang me bsad chu yi dbang : nga rgyal ri bsnyil dbu rgyan dbang : 'dod chags dug 'joms rdo rje'i dbang : phrag dog zhen 'khrol dril bu'i dbang : gti mug mun sel ming gi dbang : bu khyod rnams la bskur bar bya: oṃ a darsha dzña na a bhi ṣiñtsa mām̐: swā ratna sa ma tā dzña na swa bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa mām̐: āṃ padma pra dzña a bhi ṣiñtsa mām̐: hā tiṣṭha a nu te dzña na pa ti badzra karma a bhi ṣiñtsa mam̐: oṃ trai tsakra ma ti a mi dzña na badzra a bhi ṣiñtsa mam̐: hūm̐: rigs gcig rdo rje sems dpa' yi: sku la dam pa rigs brgya rdzogs: tshe 'das khyod la dbang bskur bas:

zhi khro'i lha dbang yongs rdzogs nas: longs sku'i zhing du grol bar shog: sarba shintaṃ kro dha oṃ āḥhūm̐ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hoḥ thod pa mtshan ldan ka pā la: ye shes bdud rtsi lnga ldan bcud: skal ldan bu yi ngag tu blud: rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga ldan nas: thig le rang dbang thob pa dang : thogs med bde chen mthar phyin shog: oṃ bho dhi tsitta a mṛ ta a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: hūm̐: khyed rnams rta phag yab yum bsgom: dbab bzung 'dren bkram tshod sbyar la: dga' ba bzhi po'i ngo bo zungs: shes rab ye shes dbang thob shog: pra dzña dzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa mam̐: shel dang me long*/ hūm̐: rma bya lug rgyud lag tu phyar: dkyil 'khor la sogs snang ba gtad: shel mig sbyar ba 'di la ltos: 'od lnga ye shes rnam lnga ste: snang srid sems su ma gyur med: ka dag tshig dbang thob par shog: dharmā kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa mam̐: hoḥ tshe 'das rigs kyi bu rnams la: rgyal srid sna bdun dbang bskur bas: bde legs phun sum tshogs pa dang : 'phags pa'i nor bdun ldan nas kyang : gzhan don dpag med 'grub par shog: oṃ ḍa we ratna a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hoḥ tshe 'das rigs kyi bu rnams la: bkra shis rtags brgyad dbang bskur bas: rgyal bu rgyal sar thon nas kyang : rgyal 'bangs mnga' 'og tshud pa ltar: dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs thob pas: gzhan don dpag med dbang thob shog: aṣṭa maṅga lam a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zas bsngo ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: gsum/ kye ma: mun pa lta bu'i 'jig rten khams su 'khyams: sdug bsngal nyams thag 'o dod 'bod pa khyod: rgyal sras thugs rje can gyis skyobs par shog: ye shes lnga yi ngang las skur sprul pa: rgyal sras sems dpa' lnga yi thugs rje yis: tshe 'das dbang po lnga yi nad bsal nas: dbang po'i nad bsal 'dod yon lnga spyod shog: sngon tshe nyid nas bsnyen pa'i lha: yi dam lha tshogs 'khor ba'i skyabs: rgyal sras sems dpa' rnam pa lnga :

lha mchog khyed la skyabs su mchi: thugs rjes tshe 'das byin gyis rlobs: ces sems dpa'i sku bstan nas/ kye ma tshe 'das rigs kyi bu: yang dag nges pa'i lung 'di nyon: nye ring brtse ba thams cad kyis: ro mchog ldan pa'i zas mang bshams: gdung ba'i shugs kyis mchi ma phyungs: zas kyi tha ma 'di yin pas: skye ba gtan gyi longs spyod zas: mi zad nam mkha'i mdzod la spyod: sbyin pa'i pha rol yongs rdzogs pa'i: zas gtad 'di ni dga' bas longs: gson yang gshin yang mi 'phreng ngo : gshin yang gson la ma chags par: bde chen dag pa'i gnas su gshegs: 'khor ba 'di na sdug bsngal che: byas pas mi zin las yod pas: 'khor ba 'di ru ma gnas par: rang gi chos nyid 'di rig pas: bde ba can gyi zhing khams na: stong pa chen po yul re yangs: 'khor ba rigs drug gcong rong che: padma bkod pa'i zhing khams na: chos nyid 'od gsal lhun re 'thug: sems dpa' sems ma grogs re bzang : de bas tshe las 'das pa khyod: zas 'di longs la bde bar gshegs: oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hāḥ lam bha ta: bha du ya yā: a li u li: ta li ta li: arghaṃ pra titstsha hoḥ hūm̐: rang bzhin shugs kyis drangs ba'i dran pas nyon: 'khor ba'i rba rlabs mun ltar 'khyams pa la: thugs rje'i shugs kyis sgron me 'di bstan pas: ye shes 'od la rtag tu bde bar shog: thar pa'i lam du 'gro ba la: gal te mun pa 'thib na yang : sgron me 'di yis gsal gyur cig: gal te ma rig rmongs na yang : sgron me 'di yis gsal gyur cig: gal te ma shes 'khrul na yang : sgron me 'di yis gsal gyur cig: gal te dag pa'i lam stor na: ye shes 'di yis rnyed gyur cig: ye shes snang ba chen po ste: sngags 'chang rgyal pos sgron me sbyin: 'di la brten nas bu khyod kyang : 'og min chos dbyings zhing khams na: yi dam lha dang 'phrad par shog: 'di nas phyogs bzhi dbus lnga na: bde ba can sogs zhing khams lnga :

thams cad 'byung lnga'i rang bzhin te: 'byung lnga shi zhes bya ba med: sems can srog ni 'byung lnga ste: 'byung lnga'i snying po yig 'bru lnga : de la brten nas bu khyod kyang : byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed de: zhing mchog de ru skyes gyur te: yum chen lnga dang gnyis med shog: 'di nas phyogs bzhi dbus dang lnga : bde ba can sogs zhing khams lnga : rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rigs mchog lnga : gang zhig de yi mtshan 'dzin pa: zhing mchog de ru skye bar 'gyur: zhing mchog de ru skye bar shog: bcom ldan rgyal ba rigs lnga la: tshe las 'das pa 'di rnams kyi: phung po lnga po yon du 'bul: yon 'di bzhes la lam 'di ston: sems 'di byang chub gnas su drongs: lam lnga sa bcu mthar phyin nas: rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas lhun gyis grub: thams cad mkhyen pa'i don rtogs nas: 'bras bu sku gsum lhun grub shog: āḥ kong bu rin chen gzhal yas khang : mar khu padma zla ba'i steng : sdong bu bcom ldan rdo rje sems: sku la zhi khro'i lha tshogs gsal: ye shes spyan drangs dbyer med thim: sku las ye shes me 'bar bas: tshe 'das las nyon sgrib pa bsreg: hūm̐: tshe 'das rigs kyi bu khyod kyi: kun gzhi'i rnam shes thab khung du: phung po lnga yi bud shing la: ye shes lnga yi me sbar bas: dug lnga'i rgya mtsho skem par shog: bdag tu 'dzin pa'i phung po la: stong pa nyid kyi me sbar bas: gnas lugs ji bzhin rtogs par shog: dug gsum 'dus pa'i phung po la: sku gsung thugs kyi me sbar bas: sku gsum lhun gyis 'grub par shog: dug lnga 'dus pa'i phung po la: rgyal ba rigs lnga'i me sbar bas: ye shes lnga dang ldan par shog: 'byung bzhi 'dus pa'i phung po la: yum chen bzhi yi me sbar bas: tshad med bzhi dang ldan nas kyang : phrin las rnam bzhi lhun grub nas: 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho skem par shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hāḥ oṃ badzra satwa sa ma ya:

sogs/ sa ma ya satwa āḥ kaṃ ka ni yang brjod/ mda' gzhu'i phyag rgyas/ hūm̐: thabs kyi gzhu la shes rab mda' bkang ste: ye shes thugs rje'i shugs kyi rgyud dang ldan: bla na med pa'i zhing mchog dam pa ru: tshe 'das mda' 'phang bzhin du skye bar shog: zhing khams 'di nas nub kyi phyogs rol na: bde ba can gyi zhing khams zhes bya yod: de na sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas bzhugs: yum chen lha mo na bza' dkar mo yod: g.yas su sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang yod: g.yon du sems dpa' 'jam dpal gzhon nu yod: mdun du sems ma gīrti dmar mo yod: rgyab tu sems ma dhi pam̐ dmar mo yod: padma rigs kyi gtso 'khor rnam pa drug: sprul pa'i sangs rgyas grangs las 'das pa yod: bde skyid ngo mtshar bsam gyis mi khyab yod: de phyir bde ba can gyi zhing zhes bya: zhing mchog gtsang ma'i gnas rab dam pa der: tshe 'das lus brjes rigs kyi bu khyod kyang : rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de yi sras mchog tu: rtsal chen mda' 'phang bzhin du skye bar shog: phaṭaḥ tshe 'das kyi rlung sems rnam par shes pa'i ngo bo: a dmar por gyur te mda' 'phang ba bzhin du: sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams su thim pas: rgyal ba'i sras su gyur te sangs rgyas par gyur cig: byang thal satstsha bya/ bsngo ba dang rjes chog las byang ltar ro/ ces pa 'di nyid sambho ka yi thugs dam bya ba'i phyir gsol ba btab cing bka'i gnang ba cung zad thob phyir/ a rā gas bsdus pa la nyes pa gang mchis bshags shing dge bas sems can thams cad bde ba can du skye ba'i rgyur gyur cig //
